testcase.name: POST /api/orders
testcase.failure:
1. Test Case ID: nWx8Xw
- Response violates schema
"49.99" is not of type "number"
Validated against the response schema for status code 201.
Schema at /properties/total:
{ "type": "number", "description": "Order total", "example": 49.99 }
Value:
"49.99"
[201] Created:
`{"ownerUserId":7,"total":"49.99","completedAt":null,"id":1,"status":"CREATED"}`
Reproduce with:
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"ownerUserId": 7, "total": 49.99}' http://localhost:8080/api/orders
